candidates.source_name: ČNB — Přehled odkazů na webové stránky bank a poboček bank z jiného než členského státu obsahující povinně uveřejňované informace
candidates.why_relevant: The regulator's own master index mapping every Czech bank and non-EEA bank branch to the exact URL of its statutory disclosure corner. This single page is the authoritative crawl seed for the whole cell: it named 24 institutions with direct deep links (Air Bank, Bank of Communications Prague, Banka CREDITAS, ČEB, Česká spořitelna, ČSOB, ČSOB Stavební spořitelna, Fio, Hypoteční banka, ICBC Prague, J&T, KB, Max banka, Modrá pyramida, MONETA, MONETA Stavební Spořitelna, NRB, Partners Banka, PPF banka, Raiffeisen stavební spořitelna, Raiffeisenbank, Buřinka/SSČS, Trinity Bank, UniCredit). It also states the legal chain (vyhl. 123/2007 → 23/2014 → 163/2014 to 30.6.2025 → zákon 21/1992 Sb. + část osmá CRR) and flags the 1.7.2025 regime change to voluntary/EBA-centralised disclosure.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch HTML monthly; diff the institution→URL table to detect new banks, renamed entities, dead links and mergers; use it as the master seed list that drives per-bank crawlers.

candidates.source_name: ČNB — Vyhláška č. 163/2014 Sb. (výkon činnosti bank, spořitelních a úvěrních družstev a OCP) — legal texts and consolidated version
candidates.why_relevant: Defines the schema of the whole cell: Part Five plus Annex 10 prescribed the quarterly template (capital and capital adequacy, exposures, shareholder/ownership structure, organisational chart, number of branches and employees) and mandated publication in Czech, in a folder labelled 'Povinně uveřejňované informace', as unlocked downloadable xls/xlsx. Needed to write a stable parser and to interpret column semantics across banks and across time (amendments 392/2017 and 354/2021 changed the annexes).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download the PDFs once, re-check annually and whenever ČNB publishes an amending decree; keep annex layouts versioned alongside the parser.

candidates.source_name: EBA Pillar 3 Data Hub (P3DH) / European Data Access Portal (EDAP)
candidates.why_relevant: The successor regime to this cell. Part Five and Annexes 10/13 of Decree 163/2014 were repealed with effect from 1.7.2025 and prudential disclosure is being centralised at the EBA under CRR3 Arts. 433/434/434a; the hub is live and holds Pillar 3 data for EEA institutions in a harmonised form. If it delivers, it replaces 25+ individual Czech bank scrapes with one machine-readable feed and makes CZ banks comparable to peers EEA-wide. Must be tracked in parallel with the national pages during the transition.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Investigate the portal's API/bulk-download and country filter (CZ) with a real browser; if a bulk export exists, schedule quarterly pulls keyed on LEI and compare coverage against the ČNB bank list to see which Czech institutions are in scope (large vs. small and non-complex).

negative_findings.description: Part Five of Decree 163/2014 Sb. and its Annexes 10 and 13 — the provisions that created the standardized quarterly 'Povinně uveřejňované informace' set — were repealed with effect from 1 July 2025. The ČNB's own bank link-index now dates the decree basis as valid only 'until 30.6.2025' and states that institutions may continue disclosing voluntarily under the Banking Act, while prudential disclosure is being centralised at the EBA under CRR Art. 434/434a.
negative_findings.result_summary: The legal compulsion behind this cell has ended. Empirically, publication has NOT stopped: MONETA (2Q 2026), PPF banka (30.6.2026), Fio (H1 2026), ČEB (30.6.2026), Citfin (30.6.2026), Artesa (31.3.2026), RSTS (mid-2026) all continued past the repeal. But continuation is now voluntary, so uniformity and comparability are at risk of eroding institution by institution, silently.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale ('Czech law forces each credit institution to publish…') is now historically true rather than currently true. Collection design must add a drift monitor: per-institution detection of a missed quarter, a changed file layout, or a dropped annex, plus a parallel track on the EBA Pillar 3 Data Hub as the successor. The 2011-2025 archive should be mirrored now, while it is still online.

negative_findings.description: The ČNB master index of bank disclosure URLs contains multiple entries that no longer resolve as published. Observed: PPF banka (404, site migrated to /cs/dokumenty/), Česká exportní banka (404, path restructured), ČSOB Stavební spořitelna listed as cmss.cz (HTTPS connection refused; entity rebranded onto csobstavebni.cz), Buřinka listed as burinka.cz (301 to burinka.csas.cz), Raiffeisen stavební spořitelna (301 into /dokumenty/), MONETA (301 to investors.moneta.cz), Modrá pyramida (TLS certificate now presents kb.cz), Hypoteční banka listed under the retired hypotecnibanka.cz although the entity trades as ČSOB Hypoteční banka on csobhypotecni.cz, and Max banka listed although it ceased to exist on 1.10.2024.
negative_findings.result_summary: Roughly a third of the regulator's own deep links are stale in some way. All were recovered or diagnosed via the recovery ladder; none were confirmed genuinely dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The authoritative index cannot be treated as ground truth for URLs — only for the entity list. Any collector must resolve redirects, follow renames and re-derive deep links from each institution's own navigation, and should re-run that resolution on a schedule.

negative_findings.description: Automated fetches were refused by several of the largest institutions' disclosure pages: ČSOB (HTTP 500 on both the ČNB-listed /portal/... path and the live /csob/... path), ČSOB Hypoteční banka (500), UniCredit Bank CZ&SK (403), Banka CREDITAS (403), ČSOB Stavební spořitelna successor domain (500). All of these URLs are simultaneously search-indexed with live titles.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as bot defence, not as dead pages. No liveness verdict is asserted here.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The four systemically important banks are disproportionately represented among the blocked endpoints, so a naive HTTP collector would silently lose the most important half of the sector. Collection for this cell needs a real-browser tier from the outset.

negative_findings.description: Česká spořitelna and Air Bank both bury the statutory disclosure set behind a client-side-rendered document hub. csas.cz/cs/dokumenty-ke-stazeni returns only a header and a loading placeholder to a plain fetch; the disclosure category is reachable only via the SPA fragment #/7/Povinne-informace-v-souladu-s-Vyhlas. airbank.cz/dokumenty-ke-stazeni exposes the tab label 'Povinně uveřejňované informace' but not the file list.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sources are live and open but not harvestable by plain HTTP; no file URLs were obtained for either institution.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two of the largest retail banks in the country are affected. Also means URL-verification of the fragment form may report a false pass (the shell loads fine while the content is absent).

negative_findings.description: Terminology in this cell is not standardized despite the template being standardized. Observed variants across institutions: 'povinně uveřejňované informace' (majority), 'povinně zveřejňované informace' (Trinity Bank, Česká exportní banka, J&T IS), 'povinné údaje o bance' (UniCredit), 'informace o bance' (KB), 'údaje uveřejňované čtvrtletně' (PPF banka), 'informace dle vyhlášky ČNB' (ČMSS), 'informační povinnost' (J&T, MONETA legacy), 'veřejné informace' (Artesa, NEY), 'povinné informace' (Peněžní dům, Akcenta), 'hospodářské výsledky' (Fio), 'výsledky hospodaření' (Raiffeisenbank), 'dokumenty ke stažení' (Air Bank, Partners Banka, Česká spořitelna). Separately, 'informační povinnost' is a high-noise term because it also denotes issuer disclosure under the Capital Markets Act and reporting duties TOWARD the ČNB.
negative_findings.result_summary: No single search string finds the cell. The uveřejňovaný/zveřejňovaný alternation alone splits results roughly in two.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any keyword-driven rediscovery or site-search fallback must run the full variant set, including the zveřejňované spelling, or it will systematically miss a subset of institutions. Disambiguate 'informační povinnost' with 'banka' plus 'čtvrtletní' or 'vyhláška'.

negative_findings.description: Three ČNB link-indexes discovered on the informační-povinnosti hub were not expanded within this slice: investment companies (prehledu-odkazu-...-is-...), pension companies (...penzijnich-spolecnosti...), and the full 35-row securities-dealer list (only the first 10 rows were retrieved). The EBA Pillar 3 Data Hub public portal was also not enumerated.
negative_findings.result_summary: Pointer pages identified and their URLs captured, but their member lists were not harvested.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The securities-dealer list in particular contains payments/FX actors (AKCENTA CZ, Citfin - Finanční trhy) that belong in the payments half of this run; the remaining 25 rows are unexamined. The P3DH enumeration determines whether the whole per-bank scraping estate can eventually be retired.

negative_findings.description: Wüstenrot hypoteční banka a.s. appears as a regulated subsidiary with its own results section on MONETA's investor site, but was not present in the ČNB bank disclosure link-index retrieved for this slice. Conversely, EEA-passported branches operating in Czechia (mBank S.A., Citibank Europe plc, ING Bank N.V., BNP Paribas, Deutsche Bank, Oberbank AG) are absent by design, since the Czech disclosure duty covers only banks and third-country branches.
negative_findings.result_summary: One possible index omission found; the EEA-branch absence is a genuine scope boundary, not an omission.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The regulator's index is the seed list, so an omission propagates into a permanent blind spot. It also means a material slice of the Czech market (the EEA branches) is structurally invisible in this cell and must be covered from home-country or group disclosures in another cell.

negative_findings.description: The session's web-search budget (200 calls) was exhausted before two planned local-language queries could run: MONETA Stavební Spořitelna's own disclosure deep link, and a direct query for the ČNB securities-dealer link-index. Both were partly recovered by direct fetches instead, but no dedicated local-language search was run for the building-society tier as a whole (e.g. 'stavební spořitelna povinně uveřejňované informace čtvrtletní údaje') or for the 'povinně zveřejňované informace' spelling variant.
negative_findings.result_summary: Coverage of banks and credit unions is thorough; the building-society tier and the spelling-variant sweep are thinner than intended.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A follow-up pass should run the variant-spelling and building-society queries specifically, since the glossary finding above shows that spelling alone partitions the result space.

negative_findings.description: No actual disclosure file (XLSX/ZIP) was opened in this slice — only the index pages listing them. Claims about which fields the template carries (capital and capital adequacy, ownership, organisational chart, branch and staff counts) rest on the decree's description of Annex 10 plus the field lists published on the Artesa and NEY pages, not on inspection of a parsed file.
negative_findings.result_summary: Field-level structure is inferred, not verified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Before a parser is built, at least one XLSX per institution class (large bank, small bank, third-country branch, building society, credit union) should be opened to confirm that the annex layouts really are identical across issuers and stable across the 2014/2017/2021 decree amendments.

coverage_gaps.description: The statutory basis for the cell ended on 30.6.2025 and the successor (EBA Pillar 3 Data Hub) covers a different, CRR-scoped population — 'large and other institutions' — which will not include every small Czech bank, building society or credit union currently in the cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Mirror the complete historical archive from every institution now, before pages are retired; then split the collector into two tracks — (a) national voluntary disclosures with per-entity continuity monitoring, (b) EBA P3DH for the in-scope institutions — and reconcile the two populations against the ČNB bank and credit-union indexes each quarter.

coverage_gaps.description: Five institution pages (ČSOB, ČSOB Hypoteční banka, UniCredit, Banka CREDITAS, ČSOB Stavební spořitelna) refused automated fetches with 403/500, and two more (Česká spořitelna, Air Bank) require JavaScript rendering. That is seven of the largest names in the sector, including two of the four systemically important banks.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Stand up a headless-browser collection tier with realistic headers and per-domain throttling before attempting production collection for this cell; verify each blocked URL in a real browser first and record the working deep link.

coverage_gaps.description: Three ČNB link-indexes (investment companies, pension companies, and 25 of the 35 securities dealers) and the EBA P3DH public portal remain unenumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Expand the securities-dealer index in full and tag the payments/FX-relevant firms; enumerate the P3DH country filter for CZ and test whether a bulk export or API exists.

coverage_gaps.description: The building-society tier (stavební spořitelny) was covered opportunistically via the ČNB index rather than through its own local-language search sweep, and two of its five members (ČSOB Stavební spořitelna, Modrá pyramida) could not be reached at all. Group consolidation is actively moving these entities onto parent-bank domains (Buřinka→burinka.csas.cz, Modrá pyramida→KB infrastructure, ČMSS→csobstavebni.cz), so their disclosure locations are unusually volatile.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated local-language pass on 'stavební spořitelna povinně uveřejňované informace / informace dle vyhlášky ČNB / čtvrtletní údaje', confirm the current deep link for all five societies in a real browser, and set a shorter re-resolution interval for this tier than for banks.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell is overwhelmingly Czech-only by legal design — the decree required publication in Czech — and no English mirror of the quarterly template was found at any Czech-owned institution. The only English-language disclosures observed were at the third-country branches (Bank of Communications Prague, in English and Chinese) and in some parallel annual reports (Trinity Bank, RSTS).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do not budget for English versions of the quarterly set; plan for Czech-language column-header normalisation in the parser, with a fixed CZ→EN field mapping derived from Annex 10, and use the third-country branches' English files as a Rosetta stone for that mapping.

coverage_gaps.description: No web-archive fallback was identified for this cell. Given that entities are demonstrably disappearing (Max banka, and disclosure pages being folded into parent-bank domains), and that the legal duty to keep publishing has lapsed, historical quarters are at real risk of vanishing without a snapshot.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a Wayback Machine / Common Crawl lookup step for every institution URL in the cell, and proactively submit each current disclosure page for archiving as part of the first collection run.

coverage_gaps.description: The comparability claim underpinning the cell — that the template is machine-comparable across all institutions — has not been tested against actual files, across issuers or across the 2014/2017/2021 amendments.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Download one XLSX per institution class and per decree vintage, diff the sheet and column structure, and document which annexes carry ownership, organisational chart, branch counts and headcount before committing to a parser design.

brief: The Czech statutory quarterly disclosure set is one of the best-organised source cells in the region because the regulator itself maintains the index: ČNB publishes six 'Přehled odkazů na webové stránky…' pages mapping every bank, third-country branch, credit union, financial holding, investment company, pension company and securities dealer to the URL of its own disclosure corner — 24 banks and 6 credit unions were enumerated with deep links from this slice alone, covering unlisted institutions (Fio, Air Bank, CREDITAS, Trinity, PPF banka, Partners Banka, Artesa, NEY, Citfin) whose quarterly XLSX files are their only structured public financial reporting, including ownership, organisational chart, branch counts and FTE headcount. The decisive finding is that the legal compulsion has lapsed: Part Five and Annexes 10/13 of Decree 163/2014 Sb. were repealed with effect from 1.7.2025 and prudential disclosure is migrating to the EBA's centralised Pillar 3 Data Hub, so the cell is now a voluntary-continuation regime — empirically still running (MONETA, PPF banka, Fio, ČEB, Citfin, Artesa and RSTS all published into 2026) but no longer guaranteed uniform, and the historical archive should be mirrored now. Practical collection is harder than the tidy index suggests: about a third of the regulator's own deep links are stale after site migrations, rebrands and mergers (PPF banka and ČEB 404, ČMSS/Buřinka/RSTS/MONETA redirect, Modrá pyramida now serves a kb.cz certificate, Max banka ceased to exist on 1.10.2024 with its series frozen at Q3 2024), and seven of the largest names — ČSOB, ČSOB Hypoteční banka, UniCredit, CREDITAS, ČSOB Stavební spořitelna, plus JS-rendered Česká spořitelna and Air Bank — cannot be harvested without a real-browser tier. Terminology is the other trap: the template is standardized but its label is not, alternating across 'povinně uveřejňované' and 'povinně zveřejňované informace', 'povinné údaje o bance', 'informace o bance', 'údaje uveřejňované čtvrtletně', 'informace dle vyhlášky ČNB', 'veřejné informace' and plain 'dokumenty ke stažení', so any rediscovery pass must run the full variant set rather than a single Czech phrase.
